items.name: Aguachile de Naranja
items.description: Sweet Gulf of Mexico shrimp crudo, Valencia orange-chile de arbol chili-water, cucumber pico de gallo.

items.name: Palmiitos con Chayote
items.description: Fresh Hawaiian heart of palm, chayote, Hakurei turnip, maggi lime dressing, sesame-chile dressing, chiltatix.

items.name: Sopesitos
items.description: Flash-fried masa cakes, pork chorizo, black beans, avocado, pico verde, salsa serrano, fresh crema.

items.name: Hongos con Shishito
items.description: Oyster, king oyster, beech, and maitake mushrooms, shishito peppers, poblano crema.

items.name: Tres Leches
